CustomField.description: Visual deployment-window decision mapped from the stable compliance reason code.
CustomField.formula: CASE(Compliance_Reason_Code__c, "APPROVED_WINDOW_NOMINATED_USER", "🗓️ Approved Window", "WINDOW_APPROVAL_NOT_REQUIRED", "🗓️ Approval Not Required", "SANDBOX_WINDOW_SKIP", "🧪 Sandbox Window Skip", "NO_DEPLOYMENT_WINDOW", "🚫 Outside Window", "WINDOW_NOT_APPROVED", "⏳ Window Not Approved", "USER_NOT_NOMINATED", "🚷 User Not Nominated", "INVALID_WINDOW_CONFIGURATION", "⚠️ Invalid Window", "", "⚪ Not Evaluated", "⚠️ Other Decision")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows the deployment-window outcome without interpreting readable reason text.
CustomField.label: Deployment Decision
